description: Enum class representing different account transfer types within the Fineract platform, including mapping from integer values and helper methods to identify specific transfer types.

classes.name: AccountTransferType
classes.description: Enumeration of different types of account transfers such as loan repayment, charge payment, interest transfer, etc.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding AccountTransferType enumeration value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current transfer type matches the given transfer type.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the transfer type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the transfer type.

methods.name: isAccountTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the transfer type is an account transfer.

methods.name: isLoanRepayment
methods.description: Checks if the transfer type is a loan repayment.

methods.name: isChargePayment
methods.description: Checks if the transfer type is a charge payment.

methods.name: isInterestTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the transfer type is an interest transfer.

methods.name: isLoanDownPayment
methods.description: Checks if the transfer type is a loan down payment.
